title: FalsePropertyExplicitNull
description: A property whose schema is the boolean `false` must refuse the key however it is written. The rule was emitted as `field != nil`, and an explicit null decodes to exactly what an absent property leaves, so {"inline":null} passed a check whose whole job is to refuse the key's presence (issue #127). The $ref spelling beside it already refused both, through the forbidding wrapper its target generates.
